text.autoconfig.originaddons.title: OriginAddons (BETA)
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.cust: Replaces the default Origin Realms /navigator menu with the OriginAddons version.
Adds additional useful information to some item tooltips.
Enable/Disable individual menus. Requires "Enable Custom Menus" to be §aEnabled§r.
Replaces the Auctions Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Replaces the Badge Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Replaces the Gestures Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Replaces the Navigator Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Replaces the Orbit Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Replaces the Painting Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Replaces the Profile Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Replaces the Realms Menu with a custom OriginAddons version.
Shows how many levels a Bottled Experience item would give you from level 0.
Shows how many levels a Bottled Experience item will give you upon drinking with your current level.
For stacks of items on the Auction House, shows how much each item in the stack costs.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.emoj: Adds an emoji picker to the chat menu.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.hide: Hides locked emojis from the emoji picker.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.bloc: Allows Origin Realms blocks to be block picked.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.inve: Adds useful buttons to your inventory.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.rock: Adds a Rocket Boots Fuel HUD next to your hotbar, showing your remaining rocket boots fuel.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.neve: Always show the Rocket Boots Fuel HUD
Prevents the Rocket Boots Fuel HUD from being hidden when in a Resource World/at Origin Isles.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.noRo: Disable the Rocket Boots Fuel HUD shaking
Prevents the Rocket Boots Fuel HUD from shaking when you are at 2 or less fuel.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.rock: Determines how the durability bar on Rocket Boots is rendered.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.crop: Adds a star icon to crop and crop basket items to show their tier visually.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.prot: Adds a shield icon to items with a Protection Rune.
text.autoconfig.originaddons.option.upda: Notifies you if OriginAddons is out of date upon joining Origin Realms.
